category_edits.rationale: Test whether reducing causal interest pooling from 20% to 10% improves next-item specificity across all four datasets, retaining the three-interaction half-life and matching training and inference readouts.

response.change_summary: Change the shared GRU readout to 90% current state and 10% causal interest mean; synchronize checkpoint metadata and embedded predictor validation. Retain one model per dataset and all other settings.
